mark.not_kept: The papers for this one aren’t kept in this browser.
mark.not_kept_text: Open it once in the current app, or drop the download in there again, and it opens here too.
mark.page_bad: This page could not be read.
mark.later: Comes with the next part of the new marking screen.
mark.which_rubric_text: The assignment card and this download’s saved work have different rubrics, so their scores would come out differently.
mark.wrap_drag: Drag to set where the text wraps
mark.page_width_tip: Wrap at the edge of the page
mark.comment_ph: Type a comment… Enter to finish, Shift Enter for a new line
mark.save_reuse_tip: Keep this comment so you can reuse it
mark.bank_saved: Saved. It’ll show up under every new comment.
mark.cannot: Not saved: this window can’t save just now
mark.m_once_tip: Drag once, then back to your tool
mark.comment_for_ph: Comment for the student (optional). It shows on the Grades tab so you can copy it.
mark.key_score: Score the row in hand (a full stop for the half)
mark.every_row: Every row has a score. To change one, click the row first.
mark.no_half: There’s no half on this scale.
mark.g_help: Click any score or comment to copy it, then paste it into your gradebook. Click a name to open that paper.
mark.g_paper_tip: The grade written on the paper itself, read from the file
mark.i_no_spread: No finished scores yet, so there’s nothing to chart.
mark.i_rows_cap: Average out of each row’s top, lowest first.
mark.i_total_only: This assignment is scored with just a total, so there are no rows to compare.
mark.i_all_done: Everyone has a finished score or a mark saying why not.
mark.i_off_scale: Read from the paper, not on this scale
mark.i_own_off: Your score is above the total or below 0
mark.i_left_out: Left out of the average by you

mark.r_from.one: From {n} student, in their own folders, ready to hand back.
mark.r_from.other: From {n} students, in their own folders, ready to hand back.

mark.r_skipped.one: {n} student has nothing marked, so they’re left out.
mark.r_skipped.other: {n} students have nothing marked, so they’re left out.

mark.r_left.one: {n} file you left out isn’t in it.
mark.r_left.other: {n} files you left out aren’t in it.

mark.r_nothing: Nothing is marked yet. Mark a paper and it will show up here.
mark.r_all_early: Everyone with marked work got theirs early.

mark.r_early.one: Leave out the student who got theirs early
mark.r_early.other: Leave out the {n} students who got theirs early

mark.r_dir_no: This browser didn’t allow saving to a folder. Use Download ZIP.
mark.r_busy: The last export is still going. It will say when it’s done.
mark.r_once: Once the students have it, mark it as returned.
mark.r_one_hint: All their papers in one file, the feedback page first. Word papers become pages too. A Word rubric you scored still goes as a Word file.
mark.r_names: Name each file by student and assignment
mark.r_names_like: Like “{name}”. Graded when it has a score, Feedback when it doesn’t.
mark.r_names_off: Files keep the names they were turned in with.
mark.r_sheet: Add the grade sheet (a crop of each typed grade)
mark.r_edit_hint: Bring a file back in later and change its marks. Files are about twice as big.
mark.r_key: Add a key to the marks used on each paper
mark.r_fb: Put a feedback page in front of each paper
mark.r_fb_hint: The score, each rubric row with what its level means, your comment, and the comments on the paper with their page numbers.
mark.r_all: Also send back files with no marks (Word files, other files and unmarked pages)
mark.r_foot: Your original files don’t change. A file you marked anywhere goes back whole, every page in order. Comments go in a right-hand margin.
mark.r_one_text: Give one student their marked paper now, without waiting for the rest.
mark.r_one_none: Open a student’s paper on the Mark tab first.
mark.r_one_nothing: Nothing on {name}’s paper is marked yet. Mark it, then export.

mark.r_one_zip.one: Saved {n} file for this student in one ZIP.
mark.r_one_zip.other: Saved {n} files for this student in one ZIP.
